selection.anime: Jujutsu Kaisen (Season 2, Episode 17 — Shibuya Incident Arc)
selection.fight_or_scene: Sukuna vs Mahoraga — Domain Expansion: Malevolent Shrine + Fire Arrow (Fuga) Climax
characters: Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga
selection.suggested_clip_window_or_moment: From Domain Expansion hand-seal (~0:35 mark in the linked Blu-Ray clip) through the fire arrow explosion and aftermath (~2:50-3:10 mark). The key 25-second window centers on the domain slashes ramping into the Fuga fire arrow ignition and detonation.
selection.phonk_artist: h6itam, n7san7os, Mc Menor Do Alvorada
selection.why_match: MONTAGEM ALQUIMIA's layered vocal chops, aggressive distorted bass, and rising synth leads map directly to the fight's escalating intensity. The track has a distinctive pre-drop vocal build ('alquimia, alquimia') that perfectly aligns with Sukuna's domain expansion hand seal and the Malevolent Shrine activation — one of the most recognizable visual triggers in recent anime. The slowed Brazilian phonk groove carries a menacing, predatory energy that matches Sukuna's sadistic demeanor, while the compressed bass drops mirror the concussive impact of the domain slashes and the fire arrow detonation. This track is already being used in JJK edits on TikTok/Shorts, confirming audience recognition of the pairing.

edit_plan.hook_0_3s: Cold open on Sukuna's smirk/grin (tight 9:16 center crop), then cut to the Malevolent Shrine hand seal on the first vocal stab — instant JJK recognition, no dialogue needed.
edit_plan.buildup_3_12s: Rapid cross-cuts between Mahoraga regenerating, Sukuna's domain expanding, and the slashing destruction across Shibuya. Time remap to half-speed on the vocal 'alquimia' phrases, then speed-ramp into faster cuts as the percussion intensifies toward the drop.
edit_plan.drop_payoff_12_22s: The bass drop lands as the domain's guaranteed-hit slashes hit full intensity. Cut to Sukuna's 'Open' moment and the fire arrow ignition — the track's distorted bass punches sync with each wave of fire. Build to the massive fire arrow explosion filling the frame on the track's peak.
edit_plan.ending_22_25s: Fire arrow aftermath — Sukuna walking through flames or the iconic shot of the destroyed crater, crossfade to black with a final bass tail. End card or logo on silence.
